# Vendored module licenses and notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-vendor-notices.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

`export-deps.mjs` and `modules/` are readable modules generated from the repository lockfile.
Fontkit uses its source modules; its small Unicode shaping tables are embedded as text.
WOFF2/Brotli decoding and SVG rendering are explicitly unsupported; the exporter embeds TrueType fonts.
Word documents use the plugin's own OOXML writer and Node's built-in compression.

**Zero unresolved build-input packages: yes.**

`LEGAL.txt` preserves upstream legal comments from the shipped modules.
`vendor-inputs.json` records every input, output module, package and bundled asset.

## Components adapted inside source packages

### fontkit-base64-arraybuffer — embedded in fontkit 2.0.4; upstream version not encoded

Declared license: MIT

Evidence: fontkit/src/utils.js identifies its decoder as adapted from niklasvh/base64-arraybuffer.

License text source: scripts/vendor/SOURCE-NOTICES.md#base64-decoder-adapted-by-fontkit.

### fontkit-harfbuzz — adapted by fontkit 2.0.4; original port versions not encoded

Declared license: HarfBuzz Old MIT (see included text)

Evidence: Fontkit identifies HarfBuzz adaptations in ArabicShaper, IndicShaper, UnicodeLayoutEngine, GPOSProcessor and GSUBProcessor.

License text source: scripts/vendor/SOURCE-NOTICES.md#shaping-logic-adapted-by-fontkit.

## Base64 decoder adapted by Fontkit

`fontkit/src/utils.js` identifies its decoder as based on
`niklasvh/base64-arraybuffer`, under MIT. Fontkit does not encode the upstream
version of the adaptation. The following complete copyright and license text
is preserved from the pinned license evidence at:
https://github.com/niklasvh/base64-arraybuffer/blob/v1.0.2/LICENSE

## Shaping logic adapted by Fontkit

Fontkit explicitly identifies HarfBuzz-derived code in `ArabicShaper.js`,
`IndicShaper.js`, `UnicodeLayoutEngine.js`, `GPOSProcessor.js` and `GSUBProcessor.js`.
The original port versions are not encoded. License evidence is pinned to
HarfBuzz 1.0.0. The full notices below retain the copyright headers and Old MIT
terms from the corresponding upstream shaping and layout files.
